gpueb_pll_timeout_read.meaning: read/log after boot timeout, not an initialization producer

lk.first_unresolved_producer: earlier than 0x1ebc8/0x1ebd8: owner/order producing MFG0 ACK and bit13 state
lk.no_inference: neither a required MFG0 regulator/basic clock nor an earlier PLL/PMIC programming sequence is established

nos.mfg0: optional absent regulator and no basic clocks; PDN [8]/ACK[12], no MFG0 sleep-bit producer
nos.gpu_rails: GPUFREQ get-only in EB mode; VGPU MT6319 USID6 VBUCK2 via mt6315 driver, VSRAM MT6363 CPUM
nos.base_dt_always_on: kernel policy only, not an LK-before-RPC cold PMIC write/ownership trace
nos.gpueb_boot_clock: gpu1/GPUEBPLL at 0x13fa0800, PCW +0xc; FHCTL uses running GPUEB IPI, not cold initialization
nos.phase_boundary: GPUFREQ GPR13 + INIT_SHARED_MEM/POWER_CONTROL is after firmware execution, not a producer for LK entry

mali_client.phase: Mali runtime power callback calls GPUFREQ; not a GPUEB cold boot/PLL producer
